chunks: Yet they choose apart from Him gods who have not created any thing and have themselves been created, who possess no power over their loss or gain, or their death or life or being raised to life again.
ai.seo_question: What are the four weaknesses of false gods mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Furqan underscores the ontological inferiority of idols, which are merely created entities incapable of independent agency. It serves as a logical refutation of polytheism by demonstrating that false gods cannot even control their own existence, let alone grant life, death, or resurrection, thereby affirming Allah's absolute sovereignty over all phases of existence.
